title: Cross-cohort seizure robustness
scientific_question: For a detector trained only on CHB-MIT people, what is its complete-Siena event performance, and how do fixed harmonization and normalization change the paired target-person outcome?
primary_outputs: Siena equal-person event F1 and paired harmonized-minus-native, normalized-minus-harmonized and harmonized-minus-timing contrasts, with mandatory sensitivity and false alarms.

data_manifest.count_caveat: Live RECORDS contains 686 EDF paths, while publisher descriptive prose still says 664. Use the pinned actual manifest; chb24 was added later.

recording_contract.neural: Actual representative EDF header has 23 bipolar EEG channels at 256 Hz, microvolt units, and 3,600 one-second records. Montage and duplicate labels vary across files; never infer all channels are distinct electrodes.
recording_contract.labels: Per-case summary files give seizure starts/ends in recording-relative seconds; companion .edf.seizures files also exist. Actual chb01_03 event is 2996–3036 s.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Summary onset/offset is relative to the EDF recording. Gaps between files must not be treated as observed background. Pinned parser matches the exact EDF filename and reads its event interval.
recording_contract.biological_ids: chb01 and chb21 are the same biological person approximately 1.5 years apart; official converter maps chb21 to subject01/session02. Split 23 people, not 24 folder names. chb24 age/sex missing in SUBJECT-INFO.
recording_contract.evidence: 686-path manifest, SUBJECT-INFO, actual summary, 6,144-byte EDF header, source alias mapping and label parser inspected; no signal samples downloaded.

recording_contract.neural: Representative EDF header: 35 channels at 512 Hz, including 29 labeled EEG channels plus EKG/SPO2/HR/auxiliary/marker channels; 2,625 one-second records. Neural-only input must exclude auxiliary and MK channels.
recording_contract.labels: 14-row subject_info.csv records patient ID, age, sex, seizure type, localization/lateralization, EEG channel count and seizure count; event files give clock-based seizure starts/ends. Counts sum to 47 seizures.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Subtract registration start from seizure clock, handling day wrap and known source corrections. Actual PN00-1 event is 1143–1213 s. PN00-3 source has an impossible one-hour-long end-time typo; official parser corrects end time to18.29.29 and handles other filename/spacing exceptions.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 14 independent PN patient identifiers, with multiple files per patient; all files remain grouped. This is a separate adult cohort from pediatric CHB-MIT, not a processed CHB subset.
recording_contract.evidence: 41-file manifest, 14-row subject table, actual event text, 9,216-byte EDF header and source correction/annotation parser inspected; no signal samples downloaded.

inputs: Genuine EEG channels with physical calibration: CHB native 256 Hz and Siena native 512 Hz, subject to source-header verification.
Native, fixed 18-edge harmonized, whole-record median/IQR-normalized, and timing-only views defined in the source control recipe.
forbidden_inputs: Siena seizure labels for fitting or zero-calibration selection
Auxiliary channels or guessed duplicate/derived montage edges
Analyst report accuracy used as detector-quality reward
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Full source panel enforces 727 unique opaque prepared records, 23+14 disjoint people and 2,908 recording-by-arm outputs. Four arms are conditions within one registration.
allowed_inputs.split: For each arm, 23 CHB leave-one-person-out jobs provide source audit and an additional all-CHB fit predicts every Siena patient. Fit/predict phases are distinct; target prediction may jointly adapt unlabeled transient state under Q1, so this is not pointwise induction.
allowed_inputs.coverage: 96 logical jobs and 192 fit/predict invocations; no recording or failed arm may disappear. Corpus bytes, true montage/reference compatibility and complete observed runtime are unqualified.

biological_unit: 23 CHB people and 14 distinct Siena people; cross-cohort means are unpaired, within-Siena arm contrasts are paired.
case_definition: One complete frozen four-arm cross-cohort panel: 686 CHB and 41 Siena recordings.

primary.name: Siena_equal_person_event_f1
primary.aggregation: Per arm, pool event counts within each of 14 Siena people and average person F1; paired changes retain those same people.
primary.rationale: Directly scores the biological target; analysis_reconstruction remains a separate calibration outcome.

secondary: Siena event sensitivity and false alarms per 24 observed hours for every arm
Target paired contrasts and unpaired target-minus-source cohort shifts
Clock-profile sensitivity, complete false-alarm localization and observed support

comparators.name: Native EEG reference
comparators.inputs: Native valid EEG channels, no Siena labels
comparators.procedure: Source median-channel log-line-length method with threshold trained on CHB people; empirical competence unqualified.

comparators.name: Harmonized/normalized reference pair
comparators.inputs: Same selected detector family with fixed 18 edges and declared transforms
comparators.procedure: Source recipe bundles montage, filter and resampling; normalization additionally uses unlabeled whole-record statistics.

comparators.name: Audited timing reference
comparators.inputs: Training-person-balanced ictal prevalence by elapsed minute
comparators.procedure: Exact fixed Laplace-smoothed timing source required; arbitrary metadata programmes are a broader comparator.

evaluation.uncertainty: Within-target contrasts use paired Siena patient summaries; CHB-to-Siena shifts use independent cohort summaries, never person pairing. Current standard errors are descriptive conditional on shared fitted models and do not establish population causality.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete 727-record/four-arm streams and exact score-to-event transformation; missing montage edges, zero IQR, ambiguous source profiles or incomplete phase lineage invalidate the full selected comparison, not just inconvenient rows.
